blind.verdict: Verdict: CLV > 0 FAILS in every cut. There is a nuance worth knowing. On board plays, the no-vig probability does move *toward* the model's side by +1.6% (CI +1.1 to +2.2) from pull to close, so the model has real directional signal. That move is far smaller than the roughly 6.5% vig paid at pull. On every line, the move is about 0. The positive ROI on board plays is consistent with variance, given the negative CLV.
